reason: V1 action predictions were fully compatible with a document-count/budget shortcut; this follow-up is explicitly post-V1 analysis.
selection: Highest dev macro-average of per-gold-action STRICT success rate; tie chooses earliest optimizer step.
training: Fresh base model initialization; standard LoRA; no changes to objective; train config configs/v2.json
max_length_rule: Use tokenizer preflight before training. Start 512; increase to next multiple of64 only if needed. No truncation.
test_policy: Do not run any v2 test model inference before dev selection. Evaluate selected adapter once; base and both fixed v1 adapters are reference controls, not equal-budget causal ablations.
stop_rule: No third round of model or data changes after viewing v2 test results. Preserve pass/fail honestly.
claims: The new dataset and longer training change together; observed differences do not identify the causal contribution of either one alone.
